comment: The fields a `_Log` payload must carry, and the ones it may. Derived from franzmq.data_contracts.base.Log, which is what the generated contracts bundle validates against. Python builds this payload from the dataclass itself; Go builds it by hand, and had no way to know it was missing three required fields -- every Go service's log record was refused by the node with `jsonschema validation failed with bundle:///_Log.json#`, silently, because a log publisher that reports its own failure through the log is a loop. This vector is how the two sides stay equal.
